title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Nadesan agrees to attend Pallavan's graduation after Nila's advice. Meanwhile, Aravind cares for a feverish Vannathi, prompting her mother to suggest him over Pandian.

title: Connect Link Pannu Win Pannu
description: Kureishi welcomes your favourite celebrities to Connect for exciting games and challenges. Watch them solve tricky clues and compete for the prize money!

title: Neeya Naana
description: An intense debate explores celebrity craze and fans' frenzy over their idols. Tune in for a crucial discussion on the risks fans take and how it distracts them from their duties.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Muthu tricks Ragu over a bus deal as Devika plans an Ooty trip for Manoj and Kanaga. Shruthi rejects her parents' invitation and vows to repay their loan within six months.
